name: labs/pymeasure__pymeasure
title: Keithley DMM6500 multimeter
intro: Keithley DMM6500 multimeter, adapted from pymeasure/pymeasure. It reads `mode`, `digits`, `measure_voltage` and `measure_resistance`; sets `nplc`; runs `measure_current`. `measure_current`: measure current on a declared channel and return the value with its timestamp and range. A hardware driver: the market serves its fake backend, so no instrument is needed.
serve_http: PYTHONPATH=mhs/MHS/sdk/src python3 -m mhs serve mhs/MHS/drivers/labs/pymeasure__pymeasure --backend fake --port 7400
serve_mcp: PYTHONPATH=mhs/MHS/sdk/src python3 -m mhs serve mhs/MHS/drivers/labs/pymeasure__pymeasure --backend fake --mcp
